name: Woodwork of Vermont
old_description: Welcome to Kitchens of Vermont, where we specialize in creating timeless designs that harmonize beautifully with the stunning Green Mountains. As a local family business with over 20 of experience, we take pride in ensuring your project is executed to perfection. Led by Adam Cyr, our passionate owner and designer, our team is dedicated to delivering creative solutions and exceptional service. Let us transform your space into a reflection of your style and needs.
about:
Woodwork of Vermont operates from Manchester Center, Vermont, as a family-owned business led by owner and designer Adam Cyr. The company has served the region for over two decades, growing from a local woodworking shop into a full-service kitchen and bath design studio.

The firm manufactures custom wood countertops — including butcher block, live-edge slabs, reclaimed barn board, teak, and mahogany — and provides comprehensive interior remodeling services such as kitchen and bathroom design, mudroom and laundry room build-outs, closet systems, and window and siding installation. It also supplies hardware, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and flooring from a curated selection of premium brands.

Woodwork of Vermont primarily serves residential homeowners and builders in the Green Mountains area, collaborating with cabinet lines from Fieldstone, Ultra Craft, Shiloh, Eclipse, Woodharbor, and Aspect, while specifying appliances and fixtures from Kohler, Brizo, Newport Brass, and Hubbardton Forge.

The company emphasizes personalized service, operating its showroom by appointment only to ensure each project receives dedicated design attention. Its founders cite a commitment to timeless designs that harmonize with the Vermont landscape as the driving force behind the business.
